body: Mob AI: 20% chance on hit to cast debuff from kind-based pool (Slime→Poison/Slow, Lizard→Paralyze/Slow, Zombie→Bind/Silence, Chaos→all, generic→Slow/Poison). 30s duration via status.Stack.Apply. removedebuffs/erase command: consumes echo-drop, removes all negative effects. cast cure (50MP/+100HP) and cast cure2 (80MP/+250HP) for WHM or WHM sub. Echo Drop added to slime loot table and item registry.
title: S99-01/02: MUD mob spellcasting AI + cure spells (WHM) + removedebuffs
